templates.template: Oracle Cloud Billing Monthly by HTTP
templates.name: Oracle Cloud Billing Monthly by HTTP
templates.description:
Monitors the current month OCI billing cost via the OCI Usage Reports API.
For Always Free tenants the cost should be R$ 0,00.
Alerts if any unexpected charges are detected.

Requires the same OCI API credentials as the other Oracle Cloud by HTTP templates.
Apply this template to the same host as Oracle Cloud by HTTP.

items.name: OCI: Custo mensal (fatura)
items.description: Custo total acumulado no mês corrente em moeda local (BRL para conta BR). Deve ser 0,00 no Always Free.

triggers.expression: last(/Oracle Cloud Billing Monthly by HTTP/oci.billing.monthly.cost) > {$OCI.BILLING.WARN.COST}
triggers.name: OCI Billing: Cobranças inesperadas detectadas na fatura mensal
triggers.event_name: OCI Billing: Custo mensal R$ {ITEM.LASTVALUE1} excede o esperado para Always Free
triggers.description: O custo mensal OCI excedeu {$OCI.BILLING.WARN.COST}. A conta está no plano Always Free — qualquer cobrança acima deste valor requer investigação imediata.

items.name: OCI: Get monthly billing data
items.description:
Queries OCI Usage Reports API for the current month billing cost.
Returns JSON: {"cost": <total_cost>, "currency": "BRL"}.

macros.description: Host da OCI Usage Reports API. Substituir a região conforme necessário.
Custo mensal (em moeda local) acima do qual o trigger HIGH é ativado. Padrão: 1 (R$ 1,00).
